# Kodable

> > Kodable is a game-based coding platform that teaches K-5 students computer science through interactive apps, NGSS-aligned curriculum, and engaging lesson plans.

Kodable provides comprehensive coding education solutions for schools, classrooms, and home learners, combining multiple app-based learning tools (Basics, Creator, Bug World) with teacher resources and professional support. The platform emphasizes problem-solving, creativity, and computer science fundamentals aligned with educational standards.

## Key Topics
